🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

Pihak berwenang Nepal mengimbau warga desa untuk mengungsi ke tempat yang lebih aman setelah banjir di sungai di wilayah tengah negara itu menghanyutkan sejumlah rumah dan infrastruktur pada Minggu (11/10). Namun, belum ada laporan korban jiwa. Dilansir AFP, menurut pihak berwenang, tanah longsor kering di Desa Chumnubri, Distrik Gorkha, sekitar 100 km sebelah barat Kathmandu, menyumbat Sungai Budhi Gandaki hingga menyebabkan banjir di wilayah hilir. Sungai Budhi Gandaki merupakan anak Sungai Trishuli. Di bagian hilir, terdapat anak sungai lainnya yang mengalami banjir dahsyat pada Agustus setelah gletser runtuh. Bencana tersebut menewaskan 1.457 orang, sementara ribuan lainnya masih dinyatakan hilang. “Kami telah meminta warga yang tinggal di sepanjang tepi sungai di wilayah hilir untuk mengungsi dan menyelamatkan diri,” kata pejabat birokrasi tertinggi di Distrik Gorkha, Dharmendra Kumar Mishra. Mishra mengatakan sekitar selusin rumah dan dua jembatan gantung hanyut terbawa arus. Selain itu, sebuah kamp proyek pembangkit listrik tenaga air mengalami kerusakan akibat banjir. Sungai yang meluap dengan membawa lumpur pekat terus mengalami kenaikan debit dan telah menghanyutkan sebuah jembatan jalan raya yang menghubungkan Gorkha dengan Distrik Dhading di sekitarnya. Perdana Menteri Nepal Balendra Shah mengatakan dalam unggahan di media sosial bahwa militer telah menyelamatkan enam orang dari jagat yang terancam bahaya tanah longsor. Sementara itu, 18 pekerja di proyek pembangkit listrik tenaga air yang kampnya terdampak banjir berhasil menyelamatkan diri. Otoritas bencana nasional telah memperingatkan warga yang tinggal di sepanjang aliran sungai di Distrik Gorkha, Tanahun, Chitwan, Nawalparasi Timur, dan Nawalparasi Barat mengenai ancaman banjir tersebut. “Mohon bantu memastikan warga di wilayah berisiko dipindahkan ke tempat aman tepat waktu serta mendukung operasi pencarian dan penyelamatan jika diperlukan,” demikian pernyataan Otoritas Pengurangan Risiko dan Manajemen Bencana Nasional Nepal dalam unggahan di media sosial. Para pejabat mengatakan personel penyelamat dari militer dan kepolisian telah tiba di lokasi. Mereka juga memantau situasi menggunakan helikopter. 📸: Dok. AFP. A massive debris-laden flash flood struck the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha's Chumnubri Rural Municipality after a landslide blocked the river flow. Viral footage captured the shocking moment a giant boulder rolled relentlessly down the grey torrent, highlighting the severe destruction caused by the sudden surge. The flash flood swept away more than 35 houses, several bridges, and local infrastructure across riverside settlements like Jagat and surrounding areas. While authorities have reported no human casualties so far, hundreds of residents have been displaced as rescue teams and security forces mobilize to assess the heavy damage. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) and local administration have issued urgent high-risk alerts. Residents along the Budhi Gandaki and Trishuli river corridors have been strictly advised to move away from riverbanks and stay on high ground. For immediate emergency assistance or reporting, contact local disaster management or the Nepal Police hotline at 100 or 112. #GorkhaFlood #BudhigandakiFlood #NepalDisaster #FlashFlood #GorkhaNews

Villages in north-central Nepal were evacuated on Oct. 11 after flash floods swept away homes and other structures along the Budhi Gandaki River. Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority evacuated residents and urged others to move to safer areas and remain alert. There were no immediate reports of casualties, AP News reported. Authorities are investigating the cause of the flash floods. The Budhi Gandaki River flows into the Trishuli River, a major waterway near Nepal’s capital, Kathmandu. The flooding comes as Nepal continues to recover from devastating floods in August, which killed more than 1,400 people and left thousands missing. #mothershipabroad

A suspected landslide blocked a stream before water surged downstream, although authorities are still assessing the circumstances and the full extent of the damage.  Emergency teams have been deployed, and residents in vulnerable riverside areas have been warned to move to higher ground. Reports differ on the number of people missing, with at least four reported missing in one update.
